verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh has a documented public REST API. The docs cover API credential generation with scoped permissions, rate-limit headers, versioning policy, sync/async/batch screening, case/alert remediation, monitoring, exports, audit trails and transactions, plus a Postman collection. A probe confirmed a publicly retrievable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema covering these resources; the 404s at generic paths only reflect a different schema location. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of an authenticated API operation, and independent user reports of driving the product end-to-end via the API.
